# Butler v0.0.13

## Change Log

- Added a native file tool path for common workspace reads, writes, and searches
  so Butler can handle simple file work with stricter workspace boundaries,
  bounded output, and structured evidence instead of relying on shell commands
  for every file operation. (#30)
- Improved worker orchestration completion and diagnostics so recovered work is
  not incorrectly blocked by stale intermediate dependency states, setup and
  review streams can close from clear report evidence, and worker activity rows
  show more useful command context. (#31)
- Hardened orchestration regression coverage for stream kinds, worker display
  names, worker dependency preflight, and Linux background service capability
  expectations so the UI/runtime contract is less likely to drift silently.
  (#35)
- Expanded Linux App distribution with pacman packaging support alongside the
  existing release paths, including package metadata and service-installer
  staging coverage for Arch-style installs. (#29)
